item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun

turns.text: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.
